# Workhorse Expands Canadian Dealer Network, Partners with BDS Fleet Service to Sell and Service All-electric W56 Step Vans in Ontario


November 18, 2026 • 7:00 AM EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_b45eb1428916e9ce26ce3fdc44c14c77/workhorse/news/2026-11-18_Workhorse_Expands_Canadian_Dealer_Network_345.pdf)


### Newest dealer partner extends Workhorse’s reach across Canada


DETROIT, Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Workhorse Group, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=kEmryiO1uM7Jtea668gpSBdmUjCZOfxKeTdEZ8LsRQhgFVMA_vnM5bNcWl66yYl8Y7TyzbFbjYQ2Bq2OllJQ8d2ItIa9IwoMgIWquQ7YlPI=) (NASDAQ: WKHS) (“Workhorse”), an American Industrial Technology company, today announced it has signed a dealer agreement with[BDS Fleet Service](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zSDsVCXlv5kll8U85tZWG3MKGJtbhPPedYjZHgBD2YMeJk2CdCMO2vq1dfEYz6VjE5t-YkF2R8Vasdc02BNHrxzTDJ-ImVlGIPfO5WbLlrQ=) (“BDS”), a Toronto-based fleet services provider, to sell Workhorse vehicles in Ontario, Canada. The agreement is Workhorse’s second Canadian dealer partnership and gives fleets across the country’s most populous province a local dealer for the all-electric W56 step van.


BDS brings 40 years of experience servicing Class 1–8 vehicles, delivering comprehensive, turnkey fleet solutions across Ontario. Its 60,000-square-foot Toronto facility features 61 service bays supporting preventive maintenance, mechanical repairs, body shop services, detailing, driver services, and specialized upfitting. Serving municipal and federal agencies as well as private companies, BDS tailors its services to each fleet’s operational needs to maximize uptime and keep vehicles working.


“As we seek to expand our footprint across Canada, BDS is our partner-of-choice to sell and support the Workhorse W56 in Ontario,” said James Griffin, Chief Revenue Officer at Workhorse. “They have a deep and trusted network of customers across the province, and we are honored they have chosen to represent Workhorse.”


BDS will offer the full line of Workhorse W56 electric step vans, including Standard Wheelbase (178”) and Extended Wheelbase (208”) models with a 210kWh battery. With cargo capacity up to 34 cubic meters (1,200 cubic feet), payload capacity up to 4,535 kg (10,000 lbs.) and a nominal range of 240 km (150 miles) per charge with the 210-kWh battery, the W56 lineup lets fleets match the van to the route.


Workhorse has sold and supported electric trucks in Canada since 2021, and is an approved supplier status in the[Canoe](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=l3gD3wHbV0McdI7GZ5s_sZfumYU5gVRKLYLImfVikOmH-7tL4do1wH4mQkQX9hnXBuexwoGfUjDFFp3T7QRclg==) cooperative purchasing program, making it more seamless for public sector fleets to purchase vehicles. With dealer partners now in both Ontario and Quebec, Canada’s two largest and most populous provinces, the company is extending that experience to a broader set of fleets through local sales and support.


“While electric trucks continue to gain acceptance in the marketplace, fleet operators still place tremendous value on having a trusted partner who stands behind the vehicles they sell and provides a reliable local point of contact for service, maintenance, and ongoing support,” said Imran Mohammed, Vice President, Business Development at BDS. “We believe our local presence and commitment to customer service will be instrumental in building fleet confidence and supporting the long-term success of Workhorse vehicles in the market. We look forward to developing a strong, mutually beneficial relationship with Workhorse and working together to build a successful and lasting partnership.”


Ontario fleet operators interested in the W56 should contact BDS at 416-757-5671 or visit[www.bdsfleet.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wizeuK0OUr3nk8cAZVnq2ik5WnFdiDtpLmog9RLgfWVhbsdR_mlvxotICQziyVXTsM9LJOrMzOYt5TZFU-VqmpilIfYeWdDoOoz0VOk_Phc=) .


**About Workhorse Group Inc.**
Headquartered in the Detroit area, Workhorse Group Inc. (Nasdaq: WKHS) is an American industrial technology company that designs, engineers, and produces the intelligent industrial machines that are the lifeblood of modern economies. From its manufacturing facility in Union City, Indiana, Workhorse applies its electrification, high-voltage systems integration, ruggedized platform manufacturing and distributed energy capabilities to its electric commercial vehicles and modular data center products. More information is available at[www.workhorse.com.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=JaM9uV6t0_VCi6hEAvqlml4ffuF-nf1xCJKQAYe0ymy2zrAmkZtBHUNhgKfLsCq8JyL-H84hWb8jx3KDxtWjN7JCTn_Vzs_BHkw_e0Duj5s=)


**About BDS Fleet Service**
BDS Fleet Service is a Canadian owned and operated company, whose mission is to be a turnkey solution for its fleet customers. BDS takes pride in providing prompt, reliable service that minimizes vehicle downtime, maximizes fleet availability, and supports cost-effective maintenance and repair solutions. Their Toronto facility is a 61-service bay operation working on all makes and models from cars to class 8 trucks. They are located at 390 Midwest Road, Scarborough, Ontario, M1P 3B5 and service all Federal, Provincial, Municipal entities as well as privately owned companies. More information is available at[www.bdsfleet.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=wizeuK0OUr3nk8cAZVnq2l9D2P08uA0ZmZ3KE40cPoTMA_M5rR_IpyZCHu7rGofHMCcomuO8Azbtxh_SF8yztwkEBpTZGGn8TcAo4gMZaXs=) .
